problem:
The equation

$$
{x}^{2}+nx+d={x}^{2}-12x-8
$$

is true for all values of $x,$ where $n$ and $d$ are constants. What is the value of $n+d?$

feedback.problem:
The equation 

$$
u{x}^{2}+vx-3=-7{x}^{2}+x-3
$$

is true for all values of $x,$ where $u$ and $v$ are constants. What is the value of $uv?$

{{field-1}}
feedback.worked_solution:
Since the equation is true for all values of $x,$ the expressions on both sides must be exactly the same. That means the coefficients of the matching powers of $x$ must be equal.

Let's compare the coefficients:

- The coefficient of ${x}^{2}$ on the left-hand side is $u,$ and on the right-hand side it is $-7.$ So, we have 

$$
u=-7.
$$

- The coefficient of $x$ on the left-hand side is $v,$ and on the right-hand side it is $1.$ So, we have 

$$
v=1.
$$

Now, we compute the product:

$$
\begin{aligned}uv & =(-7)\cdot 1 \\  & =-7\end{aligned}
$$
